parameters.content: W27 Meta asset health. Hourly at :17 and on Meta webhook events (page / whatsapp_business_account / ad account). One batched Graph call per brand (<= 50). Writes brands health fields; any NEW restriction / rejection / quality drop -> W22 urgent (both phones). Template status is synced into message_templates. Read-only against Meta. Needs env META_SYSTEM_USER_TOKEN, META_APP_SECRET, META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN. ASSUMPTION: brands.health_alerts jsonb + health_json jsonb columns exist (add them); EMQ edge (dataset_quality) is unverified: emq stays null if it fails. Writes: brands health fields + health_alerts (jsonb), message_templates.meta_status / meta_category / rejected_reason / status_synced_at (never legacy status/category), ops.notifications console row with body jsonb for new alerts.

parameters.query: SELECT id AS brand_id, business_id, page_id, ig_user_id, waba_id, phone_number_id, ad_account_id, pixel_id, waba_quality, health_alerts FROM public.brands WHERE is_active;

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.brands SET page_status = $2, ig_status = $3, bv_status = $4, ad_account_status = $5, waba_quality = $6, template_status = $7::jsonb, emq = $8::numeric, health_alerts = $9::jsonb, health_checked_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id AS brand_id;

parameters.query:
-- UPDATE only: submission is submit.sh / meta-operator. Writes the Meta-assigned state (meta_status / meta_category); the legacy status / category columns are never touched.
-- Match by brand + WhatsApp template name (wa_name), falling back to the legacy name column.
WITH up AS (
UPDATE public.message_templates t SET meta_status = x.status, meta_category = x.category, rejected_reason = x.rejected_reason, status_synced_at = now(),
  approved_at = CASE WHEN x.status = 'APPROVED' THEN coalesce(t.approved_at, now()) ELSE t.approved_at END
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(name text, status text, category text, rejected_reason text)
WHERE (t.wa_name = x.name OR (t.wa_name IS NULL AND t.name = x.name)) AND (t.brand_id = $2::uuid OR t.brand_id IS NULL)
RETURNING t.id)
SELECT count(*)::int AS synced FROM up;

parameters.query:
-- Console feed row: one per brand per distinct set of NEW alerts (24 h dedupe). Delivery/escalation is W22's job (separate row, signal_key meta_asset_health). Always returns one row.
WITH ins AS (
INSERT INTO ops.notifications (kind, "to", channel, severity, status, source, ref_table, ref_id, dedupe_key, what, body)
SELECT 'alert', 'console', 'console', CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN 'red' ELSE 'amber' END, 'sent', 'W27', 'brands', $1::text, $2::text,
       'Meta asset health: ' || jsonb_array_length($4::jsonb) || ' new alert(s)', jsonb_build_object('brand_id', $1::text, 'urgent', $3::boolean, 'alerts', $4::jsonb)
WHERE jsonb_array_length($4::jsonb) > 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.notifications n WHERE n.dedupe_key = $2::text AND n.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours')
RETURNING 1)
SELECT count(*)::int AS recorded FROM ins;
